By accessing and using B.unique (the "Website"), you agree to the following terms and conditions. Please read them carefully.

1. Use of the Website

  • You must be at least 18 years old, or use the site under the supervision of a guardian.
  • You agree to provide accurate and complete information while creating an account or placing an order.
  • You agree not to misuse the website or engage in any fraudulent activity.

2. Products & Pricing

  • All prices are listed in INR and are subject to change without notice.
  • Product images are for representation only. Slight variations may occur due to handmade nature.
  • We strive to display accurate product information, but errors may occur.

3. Orders & Payment

  • Placing an order constitutes an offer to purchase.
  • We reserve the right to cancel or refuse any order at our discretion.
  • Payment must be completed as per the payment method selected at checkout.

4. Intellectual Property

All content on this website, including images, logos, designs and text, is the property of B.unique and protected by applicable laws.

5. Limitation of Liability

B.unique shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from use of this website.

6. Governing Law

These terms shall be governed by and interpreted in accordance with the laws of India.
